verified_template_properties.numeric_reference_citations: Square brackets with consecutive numbers preferred; author-year also permitted by sample

explicit_editorial_choices_not_conferenc.labels: Short sentence-case British English labels with explicit units
explicit_editorial_choices_not_conferenc.charts: Use line styles/markers as well as colour; do not rely on colour alone
explicit_editorial_choices_not_conferenc.numbering: Separate figure/table sequences, linked by a caption manifest
explicit_editorial_choices_not_conferenc.avoid: Embedding long captions inside plot area; very small legends; decorative headings

caveats: A notebook is a reproducibility supplement; the manuscript still needs final page count and template checks.
Neither a specific plot font size nor 300dpi nor a British-English variant is stated on the submission page.
Sample template text is guidance; plot styling choices must not be represented as extra AICSET requirements.
